messages:
Raj: Quick heads-up — I'm queuing a config-only change for tonight's quiet window (16:00-18:00 PST). Changes: reduce per-tenant concurrency cap from 10 -> 6, soft timeout from 15s -> 12s, routing weight shift to favor low-latency pool (region-us-west-2), and lower batch max_tokens to 256. No model binary changes, purely routing/limits/batching.
Emma: SGTM. Are we pinning any tenants to avoid noisy neighbors during canary?
Raj: Yes — will pin autopilot and analytics tenants to existing route (no-change) for the first 30m. Canary traffic will be ~0.5% global.
deploy-bot: deploy queued by Raj. Change window: 2025-11-13 16:00 PST. Canary targets: 3 pods in gw-usw2-canary.
Sophia: Observability checklist: tracing on, per-route latency dashboards up, alerts muted for routine threshold flaps. I pushed a quick dashboard link: https://console.redwood.example/d/rt/late-change-canary
Dave: What's the rollback trigger? If p50 latency regresses >20% for 5m or error rate uptick +request-failures >0.5% above baseline?
Raj: Exactly that. Also if K/V cache pressure >85% or sustained OOMs on canary nodes. Rollback plan: immediate unpin + revert routing weights back to previous commit, then follow with full config rollback if needed.
Emma: Any tenant-facing release note? It's config-only but we should call out potential temporary latency variance for embeddings endpoints. I'll draft a one-liner.
Sophia: Re: metrics — I'll watch kvcache hit rate and TTL eviction spikes. If we see tail latency on chat endpoints, escalate.
deploy-bot: canary deploy started: job id 78645. Step 1 -> apply routing patch to canary pool.
Raj: Canary applied. Observability: initial traffic looks fine (p50 stable).
Sophia: Seeing slight drop in kv hit rate (from 92% -> 88%) but no latency shift yet. Might be expected due to smaller batch size.
Dave: Keep an eye on cost signal too — smaller batches can raise per-token cost. Is cost alert in place?
Emma: I enabled a soft alert at +15% cost per 1h on the canary tag.
Raj: After 20m of canary, p50/p95 unchanged, errors unchanged. Proceeding to roll to staged cohort (10% traffic) now.
deploy-bot: staged rollout to 10% started -> job id 78645-staged.
Sophia: At 10% we see a small increase in p95 for long-chat sessions (~8% increase) but p50 still flat. Investigation: increased early TTL evictions causing a few rehydrations.
Raj: Hmm. Do we want to tweak kv cache TTL back up (from 2m -> 3m) before continuing? That would still be config-only but may improve tails. Thoughts?
Emma: Yes, prefer tweak now. Small change, rerun canary on canary nodes only for 5m, then continue. That avoids full rollback.
deploy-bot: change requested by Raj: kvcache.ttl = 180s. Applying to canary nodes.
Raj: Applied. Monitoring...
Sophia: kvcache hit rate recovering to 91% over the next 3m. p95 drift subsiding. Good call.
Dave: No cost spike observed. Reconfirm staged continue to 50%?
Raj: Proceed to 50% but keep pinned tenants excluded until we reach 90m with stable signals.
deploy-bot: expanding rollout to 50% -> job id 78645-staged-2. ETA ~6m to shift weights.
Emma: Drafted release note: "Config adjustments to routing and batch sizing to improve stability under bursty workloads. Expect no model or API changes; minor transient latency variance possible for a subset of long-chat sessions."
Raj: Looks good. Add rollback guidance to the note: how to contact eng-release oncall.
Sophia: At 50% everything looks nominal. Preparing to unpin autopilot after 45m if no regressions.
Raj: Unpin autopilot at +45m. If any of the rollback triggers hit, we'll run full config rollback command: `deployctl rollback 78645` and revert routing weights.
Dave: Copy. I'll stand by for rollback execution if needed.
deploy-bot: rollout reached 50% and stable for 10m. Next step: auto-scaling of canary pool will be disabled for 30m to keep capacity constant during observation.
Emma: I'll publish release note and close the changelog entry once we hit 90m with no flags.
Raj: Thanks everyone. If anything unexpected, ping #eng-oncall and tag @deploy-bot-runner. :thumbsup:
Sophia: Nice coordinated choreography — config-only patches feel like dancing sometimes. :dance:
Dave: Great job.
deploy-bot: Rollout complete to 50% and holding. Manual approval required to proceed beyond 50%.
